shared_elements: low-relief carved figures on a flat panel
horizontal register/band divisions of the surface
justification: Both surfaces show profile human figures in shallow relief organised within horizontal bands, and both include an animal rendered in strict profile, but these are generic conventions. A is dominated by dense columns of script signs with small seated figures at offering tables, while B is a single processional frieze of striding figures leading a two-humped camel between rosette borders — no shared specific motif or relationship.
